name: green-level-every-spawn
note: Three IST sessions, one spawn each, asserted in full. This is the harness capability that the first conversion's bug 2 defeated: a check that inspects only the NEWEST spawn passes when only one spawn exists. Here the expectation is the whole ascending item list, so a spawn condition that fires once instead of three times fails on length. The spawn condition is the real authoring form (first bar of a new calendar day, including bar 0 via na()), so the spawn side is proved on an IMPLEMENTED terminate mode before any new_session fixture depends on it.
source:
